translation.name: Luda yã takada kũ Bisã yão

content: Yerɑ Sɑlomɔɔ u nɔɔgiru suɑ u nɛɛ,

content.text: Yinni Gusunɔ, ɑ bwisikɑ ɑ n wɑ̃ɑ guru wii sinumgiru sɔɔ.
Adɑmɑ nɛ, nɑ nun wɑ̃ɑ yee geeru bɑniɑ
mi kɑɑ n wɑ̃ɑ sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ.

content: Gɑri yi Sɑlomɔɔ
u Isirelibɑ sɔ̃ɔwɑ
Yerɑ sinɑ boko Sɑlomɔɔ u sĩirɑ Isirelibɑ kpuron mi giɑ, mi bɑ yɔ̃. Mɑ u bu domɑru kuɑ.
U geruɑ u nɛɛ, nɑ Gusunɔ Isirelibɑn Yinni siɑrɑ. Domi u win nɔɔ mwɛɛru yibiɑ te u Dɑfidi nɛn tundo kuɑ u nɛɛ,
sɑɑ mìn di u win tɔmbu Isirelibɑ yɑrɑmɑ Egibitin di, u ǹ wuu gɑgu gɔsɑ ben wusu gɑsu sɔɔ bu kɑ diru bɑni mi bɑ koo nùn sɑ̃. U ǹ mɑɑ goo gɔsɑ u n kɑ sɑ̃ɑ win tɔmbun kpɑro.
Adɑmɑ Yerusɑlɛmuwɑ u gɔsɑ bu kɑ nùn sɑ̃ɑ yeru bɑniɑ mi. Mɛyɑ u mɑɑ Dɑfidi gɔsɑ u n kɑ sɑ̃ɑ ben kpɑro.
Nɛn tundo Dɑfidi wi, u rɑɑ gɔ̃ru doke u Gusunɔ bɛsɛn Yinni diru bɑniɑ.
Mɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, yɑ wɑ̃ ye u gɔ̃ru doke u kɑ nùn diru bɑniɑ.
Adɑmɑ n ǹ wi, u koo nùn tu bɑniɑ. Win bii wi u koo mɑ, wiyɑ u koo tu bɑni.

Tɛ̃, Yinni Gusunɔ u win nɔɔ mwɛɛ te yibiɑ. Wee nɛ, Sɑlomɔɔ, nɑ sinɑ bɛsɛ Isirelibɑn sinɑ gɔnɑ wɔllɔ nɑ kuɑ nɛn tundo Dɑfidin kɔsire. Yen biru, nɑ Gusunɔ bɛsɛn Yinni dii te bɑniɑ mi bɑ ko n dɑ nùn sɑ̃.
Dii te sɔɔrɑ nɑ win woodɑn kpɑkororu wɑ̃ɑ yeru kuɑ. Kpee bɛsi yiruwɑ yi wɑ̃ɑ kpɑkoro te sɔɔ, yì sɔɔ bɑ win woodɑbɑ yoruɑ be u bɛsɛn bɑɑbɑbɑ wɛ̃.
Sɑlomɔɔn kɑnɑru
Yerɑ Sɑlomɔɔ u yɔ̃rɑ Yinni Gusunɔn yɑ̃ku yerun wuswɑɑɔ Isirelibɑn nɔni biru, mɑ u nɔmɑ yiiyɑ wɔllɔ u kɑnɑru kuɑ.

N deemɑ Sɑlomɔɔ u rɑɑ turɑru gɑru kuɑ kɑ sii gɑndu. Mɑ u tu doke sɑ̃ɑ yerun yɑɑrɑ yen suunu sɔɔ. Turɑ ten dɛ̃ɛbu bu sɑ̃ɑwɑ gɔm soonu nɔɔbu. Ten yɑsum mɑɑ gɔm soonu nɔɔbu. Mɑ ten gunum mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ gɔm soonu itɑ. Miyɑ u yɔɔwɑ u yiirɑ Isirelibɑ kpuron wuswɑɑɔ. Mɑ u nɔmɑ yiiyɑ wɔllɔ u nɛɛ,
Gusunɔ, bɛsɛ Isirelibɑn Yinni, goo mɑɑ sɑri nge wunɛ wɔllɔ kɑ temɔ. Wunɛn bwɑ̃ɑ be bɑ nun mɛm nɔɔwɑmmɛ kɑ gɔ̃ru tiɑ, ɑ rɑ ɑrukɑwɑni ye ɑ kɑ bu bɔkuɑ yibie, kpɑ ɑ bu wunɛn wɔnwɔndu sɔ̃ɔsi.
Wee ɑ wunɛn nɔɔ mwɛɛru yibiɑ te ɑ wunɛn bɔ̃ɔ Dɑfidi nɛn tundo kuɑ. Ye ɑ nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ kpuro, ɑ ye kuɑ gisɔ kɑ wunɛn dɑm.

Yen sɔ̃, Gusunɔ bɛsɛn Yinni, ɑ nɔɔ mwɛɛ te yibio te ɑ nùn kuɑ mi. A nɛɛ, u ǹ kɔsire biɑmɔ win bibun bweseru sɔɔ wi u koo win bɑndu di, bii be, bɑ̀ n tii nɛni dee dee ben wɑ̃ɑru sɔɔ, mɑ bɑ nun mɛm nɔɔwɑmmɛ nge mɛ wi, Dɑfidi u kuɑ.
Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, Gusunɔ bɛsɛn Yinni, ɑ de wunɛn gɑri yi ɑ nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ mi kpuro yi koorɑ.
Adɑmɑ kɑɑ sere kpĩ ɑ sinɑ tem mɛ sɔɔ kɑ gem? Domi wɔllɑ kun nun turɑ. Kɑɑ sere gere dii te nɑ nun bɑniɑ mini?
Kɑ mɛ, Gusunɔ nɛn Yinni, ɑ nɛn gere swɑɑ dɑkio, kpɑ ɑ nɛn kɑnɑru nɔ te nɑ mɔ̀ gisɔ.
A de wunɛn nɔni yi n wɑ̃ɑ dii te sɔɔ wɔ̃kuru kɑ sɔ̃ɔ sɔɔ. A nɛn kɑnɑru swɑɑ dɑkio te nɑ mɔ̀ yɑm mini. Domi miyɑ ɑ nɛɛ, kɑɑ tii sɔ̃ɔsi.
Nɛ kɑ wunɛn tɔmbu, sɑ̀ n mɛnnɑ yɑm mini, sɑ kɑnɑru mɔ̀, ɑ sun swɑɑ dɑkio sɑɑ wɔllun di mi ɑ wɑ̃ɑ kpɑ ɑ sun suuru kuɑ.
Goo ù n win winsim torɑri, mɑ bɑ yɛ̃ro tilɑsi kuɑ u kɑ nɑ mini u bɔ̃re yɑ̃ku yerɔ,
nɑ nun kɑnɑmɔ ɑ yɛ̃ro swɑɑ dɑkio wɔllun di kpɑ ɑ bu siriɑ. A tɔn kɔ̃so nùn win kɔ̃sɑ kɔsieyo, kpɑ ɑ mɑɑ gemgii nùn win gem wɛ̃.
Yibɛrɛbɑ bɑ̀ n wunɛn tɔmbu Isirelibɑ kɑmiɑ yèn sɔ̃ bɑ nun torɑri, mɑ bɑ gɔ̃ru gɔsiɑ bɑ nɑ bɑ nun suuru kɑnɑmɔ dii teni sɔɔ,
ɑ bu swɑɑ dɑkio sɑɑ wɔllun di, kpɑ ɑ bu ben durum suuru kuɑ. Kpɑ ɑ de be bɑ yoru mwɛɛrɑ bu wurɑmɑ tem mɛ sɔɔ mɛ ɑ rɑɑ ben bɑɑbɑbɑ wɛ̃.
À n derɑ gurɑ yɑ yɔ̃rɑ yèn sɔ̃ bɑ nun torɑri, mɑ bɑ gɔ̃ru gɔsiɑ yèn sɔ̃ ɑ bu sekuru doke, mɑ bɑ mɛɛrimɑ yɑm mini bɑ nun sɑ̃ɑmɔ bɑ kɑnɑru mɔ̀,
ɑ bu swɑɑ dɑkio sɑɑ wɔllun di, kpɑ ɑ bu ben durum suuru kuɑ. A bu swɑɑ geɑ sɔ̃ɔsio yè sɔɔ bɑ koo sĩ, kpɑ ɑ de gurɑ yu nɛ tem mɛ sɔɔ, mɛ bɛsɛ wunɛn tɔmbu sɑ tubi di mi.

Gɔ̃ɔru tɑ̀ n duɑ tem mɛ sɔɔ, ǹ kun mɛ kɛ̃si kɛ̃si bɑrɑru, ǹ kun mɛ dĩɑnun gɔɔ, ǹ kun mɛ twee, ǹ kun mɛ kɔkɔnu gɑnu ni nu rɑ dĩɑnu sɑnku, ǹ kun mɛ yibɛrɛbɑ bɑ̀ n tem mɛn wusu tɑrusi, ǹ kun mɛ bɑrɑ bwese bwesekɑ yɑ̀ n wunɛn tɔmbu deemɑ, ǹ kun mɛ wɑhɑlɑ gɑɑ,
bɑ̀ n seewɑ bɑ kɑnɑru mɔ̀ mɑ ben bɑɑwure u win torɑru wurɑ win gɔ̃ruɔ, mɑ u win nɔmɑ suemɑ dii tenin berɑ giɑ,
ɑ bu swɑɑ dɑkio sɑɑ wɔllun di mi ɑ wɑ̃ɑ kpɑ ɑ bu suuru kuɑ ɑ bɑɑwure kuɑ nge mɛ u sɑ̃ɑ. Domi wunɛ turowɑ ɑ tɔnun gɔ̃ru yɛ̃.
Kpɑ bu nun nɑsiɑ bɑ n sĩimɔ wunɛn swɛɛ sɔɔ ben wɑ̃ɑru kpuro sɔɔ tem mɛ sɔɔ, mɛ ɑ ben bɑɑbɑbɑ wɛ̃.
Tɔn tuko goo ù n nɑ u kɑ nun sɑ̃ yèn sɔ̃ u nuɑ wunɛn yĩsirɑ kpɑ̃, mɑ ɑ dɑm bɑkɑm mɔ, mɑ yɛ̃ro u kɑnɑru mɔ̀ dii te sɔɔ,

ɑ nùn swɑɑ dɑkio sɑɑ wɔllun di mi ɑ wɑ̃ɑ, kpɑ ɑ nùn kuɑ ye u nun bikiɑmɔ. Kpɑ hɑnduniɑn tɔmbu kpuro bu nun giɑ, kpɑ bu nun nɑsiɑ nge mɛ wunɛn tɔmbu Isirelibɑ bɑ nun nɑsie, kpɑ bɑ n yɛ̃ mɑ wunɑ bɑ rɑ sɑ̃ dii te sɔɔ, te nɑ bɑnɑ mini.
À n wunɛn tɔmbu Isirelibɑ woodɑ wɛ̃ bu dɑ bu ben yibɛrɛbɑ tɑbu wɔri, mɑ bɑ kɑnɑru koosimɑ wunɛn mi, bɑ mɛɛrimɑ wunɛn gee ɑ gɔsɑ, kɑ dii te nɑ nun bɑniɑn berɑ giɑ,
ɑ ben kɑnɑru swɑɑ dɑkio wɔllun di kpɑ ɑ bu kuɑ dee dee.
Bɑ̀ n dɑɑ mɑɑ nun torɑri domi goo sɑri wi u ku rɑ tore, mɑ wunɛn mɔru yɑ seewɑ, ɑ bu yibɛrɛbɑ nɔmu sɔndiɑ, mɑ bɑ bu mwɛɛrɑ bɑ kɑ dɑ bɑ yoru dimɔ turukuɔ ǹ kun mɛ mi n tomɑ,

bɑ̀ n bwisikɑ tem mi bɑ yoru dimɔ mi mɑ bɑ gɔ̃ru gɔsiɑ mɑm mɑm bɑ nun tii wɛ̃, mɑ bɑ tem mɛni mɛɛrimɑ mɛ ɑ ben bɑɑbɑ wɛ̃, kɑ wuu geni ge ɑ gɔsɑ kɑ sɑ̃ɑ yee te nɑ nun bɑniɑ mini, bɑ̀ n kɑnɑru mɔ̀ bɑ mɔ̀, bɑ nun torɑri, bɑ durum kuɑ,
ɑ bu swɑɑ dɑkio sɑɑ wɔllun di mi ɑ wɑ̃ɑ kpɑ ɑ bu kuɑ dee dee, kpɑ ɑ bu ben torɑnu kpuron suuru kuɑ.
Tɛ̃, Gusunɔ nɛn Yinni, ɑ de ɑ nɔni wukiɑ kpɑ ɑ swɑɑ dɑki kɑnɑ te nɑ mɔ̀.

content.text: ɑ seewo ɑ nɑ mi ɑ rɑ wɛ̃re,
mi wunɛn dɑm mu rɑ sɔ̃ɔsire.
A de wunɛn yɑ̃ku kowobu bɑ n fɑɑbɑ mɔ.
Kpɑ be bɑ nun mɛm nɔɔwɑmmɛ
bɑ n nuku dobu mɔ̀ doo nɔɔru sɔ.
ɑ ku wi ɑ gɔsɑ biru kisi.
mɛ ɑ Dɑfidi wunɛn sɔm kowo kuɑ.

content: Sɑ̃ɑ yee ten wukiɑbu
